final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.throws AS throws, g.cnt AS cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt AS cnt, s.share AS share FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(k.cnt) AS kept_count_sum, AVG(k.share) AS kept_share_avg, AVG(k.share - a.avg_share) AS kept_excess_avg FROM k CROSS JOIN a
